modInfo: Tucked away in a quiet residential basement lies a secret that was never meant to be found. The Aegis Vault is a high-end, pre-collapse survival bunker hidden beneath the facade of a common suburban home. Designed for long-term isolation and protection of high-value assets, it remains a silent witness to the days before the Knox Event.
